Pip pinches the note with the other paw to peel it free, and it splits into two notes, one stuck to each paw. Pip slaps both paws toward the cabinet, but the notes bounce back and double into four, fluttering up Pip's arms. Pip shakes both arms hard to fling the four notes away, and they split into eight, plastering Pip's chest and cheeks. Pip freezes, watching the eight notes ripple and settle, and realizes that every removal or transfer attempt multiplies the notes. Pip deliberately stops struggling and stands still, letting the notes rest. A sneeze bursts out of Pip, and the blast peels the notes off and scatters them across the cabinet.
